methodology.summary: This file captures source-backed suburb research for a first Supabase migration pass. Rental figures are direct listing samples or category-page observations and should not be treated as modeled averages.
rules: If a field could not be verified confidently, it is left null or called out in data_gaps.
Short-term, furnished, house-share, and estate-specific listings are flagged in notes where relevant.
